title: Automatic Adidas Hangtag Label Applicator
description:
Project Overview



Development of an automatic label application machine for attaching stickers to Adidas hangtags.



Previous Process



The sticker application process was previously performed entirely manually. Operators had to manually handle and attach each sticker to the corresponding hangtag.



Automation Solution



Developed an automatic label applicator machine to automate the sticker application process, reducing dependence on repetitive manual handling.



My Contribution



Involved in machine development and automation engineering, transforming a fully manual production activity into an automated application process.



Implementation



A total of 2 units were developed and implemented.
technologies: Machine Development, Industrial Automation, Automatic Label Application, Electrical Control, Mechanical Integration
